autopay_refund_policy: UPI autopay refunds are processed within 5-7 business days as per RBI guidelines. The amount is credited back to the source account.
autopay_cancel_policy: Autopay mandates can be cancelled anytime. Cancellation takes effect from the next billing cycle.
charge_dispute_policy: Disputed charges are investigated within 7 working days. If found fraudulent, the amount is reversed within 2-3 business days.
card_block_policy: Card blocking is immediate once the request is processed. A replacement card will be dispatched within 5-7 working days.
contact_info: For urgent banking issues, call 1-800-BANK-HELP (24x7). Email: support@bank.example.com
privacy_note: We never ask for OTP, PIN, CVV, or full card numbers over any channel.
